name: Dzimyros
source:
When a snow storm grows too wild to drive through, you are forced to abandon your vehicle in search of safety. There appears to be a small spot off in the distance, perhaps someone there could help?

Navigate your way and survive the night in this short pixelated horror themed game.
translation:
当暴风雪变得太猛烈而无法开车通过时，你被迫弃车以寻求安全。远处似乎有一个小地方，也许那里有人可以帮忙？

在这款简短的像素恐怖主题游戏中，导航并度过夜晚。
